instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the posts I bookmarked on X", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-x-bookmarks and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads your bookmarks (newest first; needs a token with the bookmark.read, tweet.read and users.read scopes) and answers each. It stops at the first page held already (held), so a pull after the first reads only what is new, and a bookmark pulled twice appears once.
4. It reads and writes no rows: the new or changed conversations and items are in the answer, and held.cursor is what to hand back next time.
